---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or capability
title: 'feat: '
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the use case first. What are you trying to do that Kerberator doesn't help with today?

## What would you want to see?

A rough sketch of the proposed behavior. YAML examples, CLI examples, or API additions are helpful. Don't worry about getting the design right — the discussion happens in the review.

## Alternatives you've considered

Any workarounds you tried, or adjacent tools that partially solve this.

## Additional context

Anything that helps us understand scope: how many workloads, which KDC, which consumer (NFS, SMB, HDFS), whether this is a hard requirement or a nice-to-have.
